sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: The "Recording of" and "Performance attributes" columns, so far only on an artist's Recordings page, are now on every list with one recording per row: recording search results, an instrument's Recordings, a series or collection of recordings, an ISRC page, an area's Recordings, a place's Performances, a work's recordings, tagged recordings (yours or everyone's), your rated recordings and an artist credit's recordings. They follow that page's own recording column (Name, Title or Recording) and load only when you click a cell's 🎼 or the header's ▶🎼, as before. A work page and a collection load many rows with one request where that is cheaper; every other page looks up one row per request. Work suggestions stay on the artist's Recordings page, the only list with a single artist. Each page group has its own checkbox under ⚙️ Settings → 🎼 RECORDING OF COLUMN (all on by default), and the first checkbox still turns the columns off everywhere.
